test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a statement followed by two conclusions I and II. Study the statement carefully and decide which Conclusion/s is/are definitely true.

**Statement:**

M > N ≥ O ≤ P ≤ W; X ≥ O > Y

Conclusion I : M > X

Conclusion II : Y < W

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II is true
Both Conclusions I and II are true.

solution:
Given statement: M > N ≥ O ≤ P ≤ W; X ≥ O > Y

Conclusions:

Conclusion I : M > X → **False** (As __**M**__ > N ≥ O ≤ __**X**__. So, no relation between M and X can be determined therefore it is definitely false.)

Conclusion II : Y → **True** (As __**W**__ ≥ P ≥ O > __**Y**__. So, as W > Y or Y 

Thus, Only Conclusion II is true

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
